description: Alerts for new procurements by the company CNPJ (requires the token edm_…): the activities (CNAE) become families of terms, and there is one alert per family, main first, up to max_familias. A CNAE outside the dictionary is listed in the response with a null family. Two modes. By `termos`: a space requires all groups; `|` accepts alternatives within a group. By `cnpj`: known activity families produce alerts, up to `max_familias`. Unmapped activities remain in the response without an alert. The cron checks every 30 minutes. Email requires an account session and `EMAIL_ALERTAS=1`. It uses explicit recipients or the verified account email.

cnpj.description: CNPJ with 14 digits, with or without punctuation.

destinatarios.description: Email recipients: `para`, `cc` and `bcc` arrays. Up to 10 distinct addresses in total. An empty `para` list uses the account email. PATCH replaces all three lists. BCC is hidden from other recipients.

bcc.description: Hidden copy addresses. Only the alert owner can read this list.

para.description: To addresses. An empty list uses the verified account email.

destino.description: HTTPS webhook URL. Ignored for pull and email.

filtros.description: Extra filter: modalities, municipalities, exclusions, values, open proposals and CNAEs. PATCH replaces the whole filter; {} clears it.

abertas.description: Require the proposal deadline to be open at collection time.

cnaes.description: Up to 8 CNAE subclasses, such as 4644301 or 4644-3/01. Matches one of the purchase's three most likely CNAEs.

disputa.description: Only purchases with competitive bidding. Excludes PNCP's not-applicable bidding mode.

esferas.description: Government spheres: F federal, E state, D district and M municipal. Records without a sphere are excluded.

excluir.description: Up to 10 literal phrases, each 3–80 characters, to exclude from the purchase subject.

modalidades.description: Up to 10 PNCP procedure codes, from 1 to 19.

municipios.description: Up to 10 exact municipality names or IBGE codes. Use UF to distinguish names.

srp.description: Only purchases marked as price registration (srp) by PNCP.

valor_max.description: Maximum estimated value in Brazilian reais.

valor_min.description: Minimum estimated value in Brazilian reais.

max_familias.description: 1 to 8 (default 8): how many families become alerts.

organizacao_id.description: Organization from `GET /api/me/empresas`. Membership and MFA are checked. Null removes the label. This does not share alert ownership.

resultados.description: Also deliver the result of each matching purchase when PNCP publishes it, on the same channel: the purchase comes back once with `resultado` (awarded value, items, date and the three largest winners). It starts when turned on, without past results. `abertas` does not apply to results.

name: create_alerts_by_cnpj
title: Alerts by CNPJ
